description: Windows 7 twin of `../capabilities/remote.json`, read INSTEAD of it by the Win7 build (build.rs points tauri-build at this directory) — same remote origins, same grants, minus `notification:default` (the notification plugin is not compiled into the Win7 build; `shell_notify` still is, and on Win7 it flashes the taskbar button while the web app's in-app banner carries the message). Keep in step with `../capabilities/remote.json`.
